_about: Energy as a service: Voltiris owns the modules (no grower capex). The grower pays price_per_mwh for Voltiris energy used on site, split pro rata with an existing PV each 15 minutes; Voltiris keeps its exports, the grower gets the export price on the existing PV only. One meter: no import while there is a PV surplus and export only up to that surplus, so under EaaS the battery does not export.
price_note: 180 CHF/MWh = 196.2 EUR/MWh of Voltiris energy used on site
